messages.author: Steinbrecher, Thomas
messages.body:
Hi Kajal, it looks like you either have not loaded the phosphate residue definition or more likely, since leap complains about only two atoms per phosphate residue, there is a naming mismatch between the residue definition and the pdb(?) input. Is there a chance your phosphate ion P and first O are named "P1", "O1" vs "P", "O" in your inputs? I'd recommend pasting the leap input and a description of what you did so far into questions to this list, otherwise any help you receive will be at best guesswork...
